tokens_received.meaning: tokens actually received by the contract after the fee-on-transfer deduction

deposit_amount.meaning: amount parameter deposited by the user via increaseTokenBalance()

recorded_balance_after.meaning: creatorBalance recorded for the depositing user after increaseTokenBalance credits the amount

contract_holdings.meaning: actual token holdings of the contract available to satisfy recorded balances

total_recorded_balances.meaning: sum of recorded creator balances owed by the contract

insolvent.meaning: contract owes more than it holds so later withdrawers cannot receive their full recorded balance

fot_token_used.meaning: The token transferred is a fee-on-transfer token that deducts a percentage on each transfer.

assumptions: The 10,000/9,900 figures are an illustrative example of a 1% fee-on-transfer deposit.
No authorization requirement is stated for increaseTokenBalance().
The deficit is realized only if later withdrawals occur.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of total_recorded_balances or contract_holdings beyond the illustrative single-deposit example; the conservation relation is stated at the amount level using the example values.

limitations: Formalizes only the insolvency impact; balance_inflation, campaign_funding_failure and quantified_deficit are not covered by this plan.
The conservation relation is bound to the illustrative 10,000/9,900 deposit example rather than a general multi-deposit aggregate.
